name: sliding_window_rate_limiter
description: Sliding log rate limiter capping requests per key within a moving time window.

requirements.description: Allow up to max_requests within window_seconds.
examples: max 2 reqs per 1s -> 3rd req in 1s returns False

requirements.description: Requests older than window_seconds expire from sliding window log.
examples: req at t=0, sleep 1.1s -> req at t=1.1 succeeds
